༄༅/ /zhargyal po jim gyis bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab 'gyur ro 'tshal bzhengs pa'i gsal byed sdeb sbyor gyi rgyan rnam par bkra ba zhes bya ba bzhugs

tei:div.tei:p: ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + rgyal po jim gyis ) bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab 'gyur ro 'tshal bzhengs pa'i gsal byed sdeb sbyor gyi rgyan rnam par bkra ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab 'gyur ro 'tshal bzhengs pa'i gsal byed sdeb sbyor gyi rgyan rnam par bkra ba zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rab zab rgya mtsho'i rgyan/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba dpag yas nyer 'tsho'i rten/ /bsdu dngos rin chen bzhi yi mdangs bzang ba/ /dpal ldan bla ma lhun po rnam par rgyal/ / dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku yi dbang chen zhal gyi dkyil 'khor ri rgyal ngos zhal sgo yi nam mkha' la/ /sgrib pa'i sprin bral ljags kyi dbang po nyin mor byed pa brtse ba'i rlung gis kun tu bskyod pa las/ /gsung rab phreng ba gsung 'dzin padmau kun nas kha 'byed gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cus dam chos kyi/ /'od zer zer ma phrom phrom 'phros pa khrag khrig 'khrigs pas srid gsum chos kyi snang bas 'gengs mdzad rgyal/ /mi dang lha min lha yi lha gyur ston pas bstan pa'i bstan pa phun tshogs 'od zer gcig gis kyang*/ /blo gsal tshogs kyi blo yi rgya mtshor blo gros padma'i bslab gsum 'dab brgya rab tu rgyas mdzad cing*/ / legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i sbrang rtsi'i don gnyer gdul bya sbrang rtsi byed pa'i tshogs rnams nyin zhing legs bsdus nas/ /chos kyi kun dga'i dga' ston bkye bas kun nas dga' mdzad dam pa'i chos kyi nyin mor byed pa mchod/ /bde bar gshegs pas gsungs pa'i gsung rab bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i thos bsam bsam gtan ro 'dzin dbang po yis/ /legs par myangs pas myangs pa'i mthu yis mthu chen brnyes shing brnyes pa'i yon tan rnam pa sna tshogs phreng*/ /spel legs rin chen phreng ba lta bus bdag tu lta ba'i yid rab 'phrog pas rnam grol sku la brgyan

| | rgyal ba las 'khrungs rgyal sras rnams dang rang rgyal dgra las rnam rgyal 'phags pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig rdzi mi'i rtse mo cung zad bskyod pa'i 'od zer zer ma tsam zhig rab 'phros pas/ /skad cig gcig la cig car nyid du bdud sde'i mun nag smag rum rab rib rab 'joms shing*/ / 'jig rten gsum du phan bde'i snang ba rnam pa sna tshogs rnam par 'phro ba'i 'od mdzad pa/ /'gro ba'i mgon 'gyur 'jig rten mgon po sras dang bcas pas 'jig rten gsum po skyong gyur cig /chos dbyings nam mkha'i dbyings las mkha' ltar ma g.yos shing*/ /sprul pa'i rnam 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs rnam 'phrul ba | | rgyal yum de sras rgyal sras rnams kyi phrin las kyi/ /rnam 'phrul la brten rnam thar bsngags 'os bsngags par 'tshal// //'dir skye rgu rnams kyi dpal dang*/ 'byor pa dang*/ grags pa dang*/ mngon par mtho ba dang*/ nges par legs pa'i phun sum 'tshogs pa'i nor bu rin chen 'byung ba'i gzhi ni bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa'i chu gter nyid yin zhing*/ der skyes bu chen po'i ded dpon rnams tshul bzhin du zhugs pa dang 'jug pa rnams kyang skal pa phun sum tshogs pa yin la/ de dag ni snyan ngag mkhan rnams kyis yang dag gi dpal nyid du'ang 'gyur ro snyam du bsams nas smras pa/ tsha zer byed pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /rnam 'phrul chu skyes rgyas pa'i tshal/ /mthong na mthong ba tsam nyid kyis | | dga' bar mi 'gyur su zhig yod/ /rgyal sras ( ¡¶ zha ¡· ba ) rgya mtshos bskor ba yi/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams kyi zhing*/ /'jig rten khams kyi rdul snyed du | | bgrang ba las kyang 'das par 'tshal/ /de lta mod kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad gang chen mtsho yi phyag mthil na/ /'jig rten bgrang yas rnam par brtsegs pa'i 'og nas bgrangs pa'i bcu gsum pa ni mi mjed do | | de yi khyon ni gling bzhi ri rab nyi zlar bcas pa bye ba phrag brgya gnas pa yi

| | gling bzhi padmo bkram pa lta bur gnas pa rnams las gling 'di lho phyogs 'dzam bu'i gling*/ /de ltar gnas 'di nges byas nas/ /dus 'di yang na nges par bgyi/ /bskal pa skad cig phreng ba ltar/ /dpag tu med pa rnams la yang*// 'jig rten snang mdzad 'jig rten mgon/ /kun tu rim bzhin byon pa las/ / bskal pa bzang po 'di la ni/ /gnyis kyis lhag pa'i rgyal ba stong*/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i tshogs rnams byon/ /'di ni bde gshegs bzhi pa ste/ /skye rgu'i tshe lo dpag med nas/ /brgya yi bar la mi dbang yang*/ /mang pos bkur ba nas bzung ste/ /zas gtsang bar du byon pa'i tshul/ /chu 'dzin tshogs las kha ba'i ri/ kha ba'i ri las chu bo'i rgyun/ /chu bo'i rgyun las chu bo'i gter/ /chu gter che las rin chen bzhin/ /zas gtsang sras pos zag pa rnams spangs zag med bdud rtsi gsol ba las/ /zag med gzigs pas zag med sku brnyes gsung gi rnam 'phrul sna tshogs kyi/ /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyis bsdus 'khor lo rim pa gsum bskor bas/ /'jig rten gsum du 'jig rten mtha' dag chos kyi dga' bdes dga' bar mdzad/ /'od zer brgya pa'i 'od zer gyis/ / chu skyes rgyas shing mun pa bsal/ /dngos rnams gsal byed gza' skar rnams// zil gyis gnon pa lta bur mchis/ /srid gsum 'gro ba kun gyi dpal/ /thub dbang bstan pa rin chen gter/ /lnga brgya phrag bcur gnas pa las/ /lnga brgya bdun pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /'dzam gling byang phyaugs sa yi char/ /bsod nams chen po'i chu gter las/ /jing gir gan zhes grags pa yi/ /sa 'dzin rin chen 'khrungs par gyur/ /de sras go gan rgyal po zhes/ /grags pa'i mi dbang gnyis pa yang*/ /mthu stobs nyi ma lta bu yi/ /gzhan sde'i mun pa rnam par bcom/ /de sras go yug gan zhes pa'ang*/ /srid la dbang ba'i rgyal por gyur/ /de yi yab chen go ( ¡¶ zha ¡· mong ) go gan/ /mthu yi rgyal srid rnam par bzung*/

/yid skyes kha lo sgyur ba yi/ /mi yi bdag po byung bar gyur/ /de gcung go pe la zhes pa/ / bsod nams nyi ma'i gzi brjid kyis/ /pha rol mun pa zil mnan nas/ / bka' yi rgyal srid skyong bar gyur/ /gtsug lag kun la thugs gsal zhing*/ / chos kyis rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong*/ /mthu yis sa la dbang sgyur ba/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal lta bur gyur/ /rgyal dbang 'di yi gzi brjid phung po yis/ / gzi ldan gza' dbang dbang du bsdus byas nas/ /phyogs bcu rnams su gsung gi gsung zer ni/ /tsha zer zer ltar rnam par spros snyam byed/ /chos bzhin mdzad par gzhol ba yi/ /rgyal po de sras thu bo ni/ /jim gyim btsun mo go go can | | jim gyim 'khor los sgyur sras bzhin/ /mtho ris yon tan dpal brnyes shing*/ /dad dang snying rjes brgyan pa'i thugs/ /chos kyi tshul la rab 'byor bas/ /kun tu grags pas khyab par gyur/ /'di yi dpal 'byor grags pa mthu stobs ni/ /lha yi dbang po'i dpal 'byor ji bzhin te/ /rgyal ba'i gsung bzhin bsgrub pa'i rnam 'phrul yang*/ /rgyal sras rnams la 'gran pa lta bur snang*/ /yang na 'di yis dpal 'byor rin chen tshogs/ /klu yi dbang pos dga' mgur byin pa bzhin/ /bka' yi srid 'bangs kha lo sgyur ba ni/ /skye rgu'i bdag pos byin pa ji bzhin no/ /de ltar bsod nams ldan pa'i dpal/ /ma bsgrubs par yang rang nyid 'du/ /ma brtsad par yang dgra bo thul/ /ma bstod par yang ngang gis mtho/ /'di ni spyod tshul tshul bzhin bsgrub pa dam pa'i rgyan gyis rab brgyan zhing*/ /dge ba bsgrub pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gnyen gyi mchog gis legs bzung rnams/ /rgyal bas bsngags pa'i bsngags kyi spyod tshul theg pa mchog la rab zhugs pas/ /kun tu rtogs pas kun nas brtags pa'i lta spyod rnams las rnam par grol/ khyad par du yang khyad par 'phags pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten/

/bzhengs dang 'bri dang mchod dang rab gnas mchod bstod sogs/ /rgyal ba'i rigs bskrun bla ma'i gsung bzhin rgyal bas bsngags pa'i lam/ /bsgrub pa'i tshul la tshul gzhan dor nas tshul bzhin zhugs par gyur// /khyad par du 'phags pa'i gdung rgyud chen por 'khrungs shing*/ ya rabs rnams la 'os pa'i 'jig rten gyis spyod tshul bzang pos rnam par brgyan pa'i sems dpa' chen po rnams ni/ mtsho skyes rnam par rgyas pa'i pad tshal chen por sbrang rtsi spyod pas mthong ba ltar skye bo thams cad kyi yid 'phrog par 'gyur zhing*/ thub pa'i dbang po'i gsung rab dang rjes su mthun pa'i bya ba bsgrub pa rnams ni snyan ngag mkhan rnams kyis bsngags par 'os pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ lha rnams kyis kyang nam mkha' las a la la zhes shin tu dga' ba dang*/ spro ba'i sgra dbyangs kyis bstod de ched du brjod par 'gyur ro snyam du sems so/ /de bas na 'di'i rmad du byung ba'i bya ba yangs 'du'i me tog lta bu'i tshogs ni skye bo gzhan dang bar bya ba'i slad du yang ched du brjod par 'os so/ /zhes bsams te smras pa/ gzhan yang yab mes bla ma'i bka' dran bsam phyir dang*/ /rgyal srid dpal 'byor rgya cher rnam par rgyas phyir dang*/ /rang nyid mched bcas yum sras bde zhing byang chub phyir/ /chos kyi bya ba chos las 'byung ba 'di ltar bsgrubs/ /shing mo phag lo ston gyi zla ba la/ / nyid kyi chab srid smar khams tsom mdo ru/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ /gdul bya dag pa srid dang zhi ba yi/ /pha rol phyin byed pha rol phyin pa na/ /rin chen gser sogs rin thang med pas bzhengs/ /de bzhin du yang me mo glang lo la/ /rgya che'i don ston sangs rgyas phal po che/ /rin chen mthing shog khyad par 'phags bskur nas/ /bzo gnas mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis sa skyar bzhengs/ /de yi de ltar yang nas yang du ni/

/dge dang dge 'bras spel phyir de de ltar/ /mdzad pas mdzad pa'i tshul la tshul bzhin du/ /dgongs pas dgongs pa 'phel nas yang 'di bzhengs// //rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rab mchog /rdo rje theg pa rgya mtsho'i don/ /rgyud sde du ma'i rin chen rnams/ /gcig tu bsdus pa rgyud 'bum dang*/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i snying po mchog /rgyal ba sras bcas bskyed pa'i yum/ /'gro ba'i bde legs mi zad gter/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma gang*/ /stong phrag brgya par gsungs pa gang*/ /stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa dang*/ /de bzhin stong phrag brgyad pa dang | khri pa dang ni khri brgyad stong*/ /yon tan rin chen bsdud pa dang*/ /shes rab snying po la sogs pa/ /rgyal yum dbye ba med pa zhig /thub pa'i gsung gcig gis gsungs kyang*/ /mos pa tha dad dbye ba yis/ /sde tshan mang du bzhugs pa dang*/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras phrin las dang*/ /zhing dang 'gro ba'i bkod pa sogs/ /rab 'byams rgya mtsho ston pa'i mdo/ /sangs rgyas phal po che dang ni/ /gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu rnams/ khyad par rmad byung ston pa yi/ / rin chen spungs pa lta bu'i mdo/ /dkon mchog brtsegs par grags pa dang*/ / drang ba'i don dang nges don dang*/ /sde snod gsum dang bslab pa gsum/ /theg pa gsum gyi dbye ba yis/ /gsungs pa'i mdo sde mang po dang*/ /bde gshegs bstan pa rin chen sgron/ /'dzin pa shākya'i sras rnams kyi/ /spyod pa phun tshogs ston pa'i mdo/ /'dul ba lung du grags pa ste/ /sdud pa po yis legs bsdus nas | | lo paṇa rnams kyis legs bsgyur ba/ /'gyur ro 'tshal du grags pa rnams | | bde gshegs tsha zer rgyal po'i gsung zer lta bu'i 'od zer gyis/ / rnam par rgyal ba rgyal ba'i gsung rab pad tshal lta bu'i skyed mos tshal/ /bde legs dpal 'byor 'byor pa'i bdud rtsi sbrang rtsi lta bus rnam brgyan pa/ / gdul bya bung ba dga' ba'i dga' ston dga' mgur spyod pa bzhengs dgongs nas

| | bzhengs par byos zhes bka' lung stsal ba'i gsung*/ /gsung bzhin bsgrub pa'i skyes bu du ma yis/ /sa pho stag gi dbyar gyi dus bab tshe/ /rgya bod mtshams kyi chu ma mkhar zhes byar/ /mthing shog mthon thing glegs bu lta bu'i gzhir | | 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser mchog btso ma las/ /'phrul yig yig mkhan da rigs la sogs kyis/ /gser phreng lta bur yid rab 'phrog pa bkod/ /sna tshogs bzo rig mkhas pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dras dang glegs shing glegs thag na bza' sogs/ /'gro ba'i yid 'phrog phul du byung ba yi/ /rnam par bkra ba phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub/ /dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho lta bu yis/ /thub dbang gsung bzhin rab gnas legs bsgrubs pas/ /bde legs dpal 'byor lhag par 'phel ba'i gzhi/ /skye rgu rnams kyis mchod pa'i rten du 'gyur/ khyad 'phags skyes bu du mas bsgrub bya ba/ /ngo mtshar skye bo kun gyi yid rab 'phrog | 'phags pa rnams kyi spyod pa'i rnam 'phrul yang*/ /'jig rten gsum du 'gro ba'i yid 'phrog yin/ /tshul 'di tshul la mkhas pa'i tshul lta yi/ /snyan ngag mkhan gyi dpal gyis legs spel ba/ /snyan ngag gtsug lag tshul la mkhas rnams kyis/ /legs par gsan nas tshul bzhin brtag par mdzod/ / gser gyi yig phreng gis spras pa'i/ /mthing shog mthon ka chen po'i mdangs/ / gsal ba rnam gsal nyi ma yi/ /gzi brjid zil gyis gnon pa bzhin/ /yang na mthing shog mthing ga'i mdangs/ /nam mkha' dwangs pa'i kha dog bzhin/ / gser yig phreng du sbrengs pa ni/ /rgyu skar phreng du dngar ba bzhin/ /yang na rnam par gsal ba'i zhing*/ /bai ḍūrya yi sa gzhi la/ /rnam 'phrul sna tshogs kun 'phrul ba'i/ /thub pa'i sprul sku bkram pa bzhin/ /gug skyed yan lag yi ge yi | | rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa ni/ /lha dang 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams kyis | | de yi rim gro bgyi ( ¡¶ zha ¡· bgyid ) pa bzhin/

/klog mkhan mkhas pas yi ge'i phreng*/ /klog pas klog gi sgra dbyangs ni/ /thub dbang yan lag drug cu yi | | gsung gis gsung rab gsungs pa bzhin/ /klog skad rgyud mangs sgra dbyangs kyis/ /skye bo 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i yid/ /tshim zhing dang bar bgyis pa ni | | chos kyi 'khor los gdul bya bzhin/ /glegs bam stobs bcu mnga' ba'i sku | | mdzes pa de yi 'dzum pa'i mdangs/ /'od zer bde bar gshegs pa'i 'od | | glegs shing rnam bkra mtshan dpe'i rgyan/ /na bza' rnam par bkra ba yis | | glegs bam rnam par brgyan pa gang*/ /snam sbyar snam phran glegs bu'i tshogs | | bsgrigs pas thub sku brgyan pa bzhin/ /de ltar bsod nams 'bad rtsol legs par sbyor ba'i chu yi chu gter chen po las/ /mthing shog 'dab mar yig phreng me tog mdzes pa'i dri ldan phan bde'i grib bsil can/ /dpal 'byor phun tshogs 'bras bu bcas pa'i dpag bsam ljon shing rnam par rgyas pa gang | | lha dang lha min mi dang klur bcas ma lus 'gro ba'i 'dod rgu'i 'byung gnas 'di 'khrungs so/ /'di tsam nyid du mtshar ba'i ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba/ / 'chi med yul du 'chi med bu mo mdzes ma rnams kyis/ /'chi med dbang po dga' mgur mnyes par bgyi ba'i slad du/ /'chi med yul gyi rol mo'i rnam 'phrul sna tshogs bgyi 'dra//

//'di ltar sems dpa' chen po 'di'i bya ba 'di tsam du ngo mtshar ba lha'i yul gyi dpag bsam gyi shing gi me tog rnams lha'i bu mo rnams kyis me tog phreng bar bsgrigs te nam mkha' las dpyangs pa'am/ klu'i yul gyi rin po che'i rigs rnam pa sna tshogs pa du ma rnams klu'i bu mo rnams kyis rin po che'i phreng bar bsgrigs te/ ri rab lhun po'i ngos las dpyangs pa ltar yid 'phrog pa ni shin tu yang bsngags par 'os la/ 'di'i 'bras bu yang khyad par du 'phags pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba smos ci dgos/ des na sems dpa' chen po 'di'i 'khor rnams kyang shin tu dga' ba 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' ba'i rigs so/ / snyam na smras pa/ 'di yi snyan ngag mkhan rnams la/ /snyan ngag rgyan du gdams pa bzhin/ /snyan ngag mkhan po rnams kyis kyang*/ /lan du snyan ngag brjod pa bzhin | | dge ba 'di dang dge gzhan 'dres pa bdag gzhan ma lus kun/ / kun tu kun dga'i gter la kun nas spyod tshul bzang po 'dis/ /'di ltar tshul bzhin ston ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + pa ston ) pa'i gsung rab zab mo'i chos/ /chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ba smos ci 'tshal/ /de ltar gsung rab rin chen gser gyis rab bzhengs nas/ /bklags dang mchod dang bstod pa'i dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan/ /ma lus blo yis gcig tu bsdoms nas rjes su yi rang gis/ /rnam spel dge ba'i rgyal sras jim gyim yab yum mched zlar bcas | | btsun mo dam pa go go can dang sras kyi thu bo ni/ /ka ma la dang dharma pha la de bzhin de mur dang*/ /sras mo gu log gī ti zhes bya gzhan yang 'byon 'gyur pa'i/ /gdung rgyud 'khor dang rgyal srid bcas pa thams cad dus kun tu | | chu bo'i rgyun ltar sku tshe ches cher ring ba dang*/ /lhun po'i ri ltar dpal 'byor ches cher mtho ba dang*/ /'jig rten dbang ltar dbang phyug ches cher rgyas rgyur cig /skye ba skye bar rgyal ba rgya mtsho las/

/nyin re nyin rer dam chos legs nod cing*/ /gang dang gang du skyes pa thams cad du/ /dge dang dge ba'i dpal 'byor 'byor par shog /gzhan yang rang gzhan bde gshegs gsung*/ / gsung rab rgya mtsho'i 'gro ba'i bla/ /bla ma'i gsung bzhin bsgrubs pa'i mthus// mthu ldan stobs bcu brnyes par shog /de ltar gsung rab rgya mtsho rgya mtsho ltar// zab cing rgya che rgya cher legs gsungs pa/ /nye bar bzhengs tshul tshul bzhin brjod cig ces/ /lha des bskul nas bskul bzhin 'phags pas sbyar// // rgyal po chen po dbang phyug dam pa'i dpal gyis rnam par 'byor pa go pe la gan rgyal po ¡Ã zhes ( ¡¶ zha ¡· kun shes ) kun tu grags pa'i sras kyi dam pa/ rgyal po jim gyim zhes bya bas/ gsung rab rin po che mtha' dag rin po che gser gyis bzhengs pa'i tshul/ tshul bzhin du brjod pa'i rab tu byed pa 'di ni dge slong 'phags pa zhes bya bas/ sa pho stag gi lo smin drug gi zla ba'i tshes lnga'i nyin par dpal sa skya'i ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + gtsug lag ) chos grwa chen po sbyar ba'o// // ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + ༄༅/ /jim gyim gyis rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bzhengs pa/ / ) ༄༅/ /chos rin po che nye bar bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed kyi rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo | | tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i chu gter las 'khrungs shing*/ /mkhyen brtse'i lo 'dab kun nas rab rgyas la/ /phrin las dri bsung phyogs bcur rab ldang ba | | sangs rgyas rnam par rgyas pa'i padmo rgyal/ /dam chos yongs su smin pa'i sbrang rtsi ltar/ /srid zhi'i phun tshogs skyes pa'i bcud ldan zhing*/ /gang gis myang ba'i dpal du nyer 'gyur ba/ /gsung rab bdud rtsi 'gro la rgyal gyur cig / dam chos bdud rtsi'i blo gros lus rdzogs shing*/ /rnam grol rig pa'i 'dab gshog rab rgyas nas/ /legs bshad sgra dbyangs kun tu legs sgrogs pa/

/ dge 'dun bung ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhi ba zag med dbyings la nyer brten zhing*/ /dkon mchog dge ba de dag 'byung ba'i gnas/ /nyes pa bkru ba'i 'jug ngogs mchog gyur pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i pad rdzing gis skyongs shig | gang gi rang bzhin gdod nas rnam dag glo bur spros pa'i spros bral yang | | sprul pa'i spros pa kun tu spro mdzad dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus dang*/ / spros dang spros med zung du chud gyur rgyal sras rnams dang de bzhin du/ /spros pas ma spros slob dang mi slob slob ma'i tshogs bskyed yum la 'dud/ /yum de yi ni sras gyur pa'i/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams kyi zhing*/ /'jig rten khams ni bgrang yas las/ /'di ni mi mjed 'jig rten khams/ /dus ni bskal pa bzang po la/ /gnyis kyis lhag pa'i sangs rgyas stong*/ /'gro ba'i don du byon pa las/ /rnam 'dren rnam pa gsum gyi rjes/ /skye rgu'i tshe lo brgya pa'i tshe/ / shākya'i rgyal po nye bar byon/ /bstan pa lo grangs lnga brgya phrag /bcu ru gnas par gsungs pa las/ /lnga brgya bdun pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi byang phyogs char/ /sngon spyad dpal gyis mthus byung ba/ /rgyal po gzhan gyi dpal 'phrog cing*/ /rang dpal rnam par rgyal gyur pa/ /jing gir gan zhes bya ba byung | | de sras sa bdag gnyis pa ni/ /ga gan rgyal po zhes bya ba/ /des kyang phyogs gzhan zil mnan nas/ /dpal gyi gzi yis lham mer bzhugs/ /de yis sras gyur go yug gan/ /de yang mi yi dbang por gyur/ /de yi yab mched mang go gan/ /stobs kyi 'khor lo sgyur 'drar gyur/ /de gcung go pe la zhes bya ba | | de ni gtsug lag kun la thugs/ /rnam par gsal zhing gsal bar smra/ / drang po'i chos rjes 'brang ba ste/ /dge zhing bden pa'i mthu yis te/ /sa rnams kun la dbang bsgyur ba/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal nyid bzhin gyur/ /de ni zhi bas sa skyong zhing*/

/dkon mchog mchod la mngon par gzhol/ /chos kyis bdag gzhan dpal 'phel mdzad/ /de yi sras ni jim gyim ste/ /mtho ris dpal gyi gzhi brten zhing*/ /dad dang thugs rje mkhyen rab kyis/ /de yi thugs ni rnam par 'byor/ /yab mes brgyud pa las brgyud pa'i/ /lugs kyis 'jig rten legs skyong zhing*/ /'chi med chos kyi bdud rtsi'i sgor/ /chos bzhin zhugs nas chos tshul la/ /tshul bzhin spyad pas tshul bzhin du/ /nyid kyi dpal 'byor rab rgyas nas/ /gzhan 'byor dag kyang 'byor mdzad pas/ /grags pa'i nyi 'od nyi ltar gsal/ /'di yi mdzad spyod theg pa mchog gi brtul zhugs dam pas legs brgyan pa'i/ /thub dbang gis kyang bsngags par 'os pa'i sdom la gnas shing de bzhin du/ /mthar lta ba yi lta ba kun las rnam par grol zhing dbu ma yi/ /yang dag lta bas lta ba rnam dag sgrub pa bzang pos bsgrubs pa la | | nye bar gzhol bas gzhal du med pa'i bsod nams tshogs bskrun dam pa yi | | nye bar bsngags pa'i dkar po'i las la gcig tu brtson mdzad khyad par du | | sangs rgyas sku gzugs bzhengs nas mchod dang dam chos 'dri dang klog pa dang*/ /dge 'dun mchod sogs thar pa'i 'jug ngogs mchog la nges par 'di zhugs so/ /'di yi yab mes dag gi bka' drin la/ /kun nas lan du blan par bya phyir dang*/ /rang gi bla med byang chub thob bya'i phyir/ /dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus bskyed pa'i yum/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam | | lhar bcas 'gro ba'i bde legs 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma shes bya ba/ /stong phrag brgya yi tshad du gsungs pa gang*/ /nye bar bzhengs zhes bka' lung legs stsol nas/ /de gsung spyi bor dang du len byed pa | | ston tshul zhes byas bdag rkyen legs byas te/ /shing mo phag lo'i ston zla rnam gsum la/ /bai ḍūrya 'dra'i zhing sa dag pa'i gzhir/ /'dzam bu'i chu gser zhun ma'i rang bzhin gyis/

/'phrul gyi yi ge'i bzo la legs sbyangs pa/ /sum pa dge slong tshul khrims dpal dang ni/ /bkra shis dpal sogs mkhas pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /legs par bris nas sna tshogs rig pa yi/ /bzo ba'i tshogs kyis dras dang glegs shing sogs/ /kun nas dge shing phun sum tshogs par bsgrubs/ /rab tu gnas pa'ang gsung rab ji bzhin du/ /dge 'dun rgya mtsho rgya mtsho lta bus bgyis/ /de ltar grub pa'i dpal 'bras dam pa 'di/ / lhar bcas 'gro ba'i mchod pa'i rten du gyur/ /de yi tshul yang tshul bzhin du/ / snyan ngag snyan pas legs brjod cing*/ /lha dang lha min tshogs rnams dang*/ /mi dang mi'am ci la sogs/ /'byung po gang dag 'dir lhags rnams/ /rna ba blags te mnyan par gyis/ /glegs shing gser gyis mdog snang ba/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs 'od 'byin pa ni/ /thub pa dges pas nyid sras la/ /'dzum pa mdzad pa lta bur gda'/ /glegs shing phye bas nang gi mdangs/ /dmar zhing kun nas 'tsher ba ni/ /rgyal ba'i zhal gyi sgros gsal nas/ /ljags kyi dbang po bkram 'drar mchis/ /mthing shog mthing ga'i mdangs chags la/ /dbang po'i gzhu yi 'od 'byin pa/ /ljags las bye ba khrag khrig 'od/ /kun nas 'byin pa lta bu gda'/ /gser gyi yi ge gser phreng ltar/ /phreng du dngar zhing bstan pa ni/ /ljags kyi 'od kyi rtse mo la/ /thub pa'i sku gzugs bkram 'drar mchis | | yi ge'i gug skyed gang 'og tu/ /lding zhing 'khyug par gnas pa ni/ / sprul pa'i sku la rgyal sras dang*/ /slob mas zhabs 'bring bgyis 'drar gda'/ / yi ge de 'dra klog pa la/ /shin tu mkhas pas bklags pa'i sgra/ /yan lag drug cu'i gsung dbyangs kyis/ /don de nyid ni ston 'drar mchis/ /klog gi sgra yis der 'dus pa'i/ /skye bo'i yid ni zhi bgyid pa/ /chos thos pa yi 'khor rnams kyis | | chos don bden pa mthong 'drar gda'/ /'di 'dra'i dge bas bdag gzhan kun/

/dge bar bgyis khyod 'di 'bras kyis/ /myur du phyogs bcur chos sgrogs pa'i/ /chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur lags grang*/ /de ltar dam chos rin chen ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + rin chen ) gyi/ /nye bar bzhengs nas mchod dang bklags pa yi | | dge ba 'di dang dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan/ /gcig tu bsdoms nas rgyal sras jim gyim dang*/ /btsun mo dam pa go go can dang ni/ /sras kyi thu bor gyur pa ka ma la/ /gny-is par gyur pa dharma pha la dang*/ /gsum pa de mur dang ni de bzhin du/ /sras mo gu log gī ti zhes bya dang*/ /slad nas 'byon par 'gyur ba'i gdung rgyud bcas/ /gnas skabs sku tshe chu bo'i rgyun ltar ring*/ /dpal 'byor rgya mtsho che ltar ngang gis 'phel/ /lha yi dbang po lta bur dbang dang ldan | | tshangs dbang lta bur nad med bder gnas shing*/ /grub pa'i lha dang rig pa 'dzin pa ltar/ /bzhed rgu thams cad chos bzhin 'grub gyur cig /srid pa kun tu lha ma'i dpal 'byor gyis/ /rnam par 'byor zhing rgyal ba rgya mtsho las | | chos tshul rgya mtsho gsan nas legs spyad de/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang brnyes par shog /de ltar bsngags 'os bsngags dang bsngo ba yi/ /rab byed 'di ni dge slong 'phags pa yis/ /me pho byi ba dpyid zla ྄ra ba yi/ /bcu bzhi'i nyin par smar khams sgang du bris/ /phyogs dang dus thams cad du bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /dam chos rin po che shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod bzhengs ¡Ã pa la bsngags pa ( ¡¶ zha ¡· pa'i gsal byed ) bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dam pa'i chos rin po che shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod bzhengs pa'i tshul bstan pa'i rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhi ba gdong bzhi mig stong ldan pa dang*/ / dpal mo'i dpal dang klu dbang stobs ldan sogs/ /'jig rten mchod 'os rnams kyis gus mchod pa'i/ /thub dbang zhabs kyis padmor rtag tu 'dud/

/ des gsungs dri med rnam dag bdud rtsi'i gsung*/ /gsung rab rmad byung zhi lam 'jug pa'i sgo/ /sgo gsum gus pas brten na bde dang legs/ /legs rtsol dam pa'i chos la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /tshul khrims me tog legs spyad mdangs bkra zhing*/ /dge legs ze'u 'bru snyan pa'i dri bsung ldang*/ /rtog pa'i sny-ing po gzhan phan sbrang rtsi can/ /dge 'dun padmo rgyas pa rgyas gyur cig /legs spyad gser gyi sa gzhi las 'khrungs shing*/ /brtse ba'i lhun mdzes phan bde'i lo 'dab can/ /rnam grol 'bras ldan bsdu ba'i bsil grib kyis/ /nyon mongs gdung sel dpal ldan bla mas skyongs/ /gang zhig chos dbyings nam mkha'i dbyings ltar rnam dag spros pa kun las rnam grol yang*/ /zung 'jug 'od gsal thabs tshul mchog brnyes nyi zla'i 'od kyis 'od gzhan zil mnan nas | | sna tshogs skar ma'i tshogs ltar rab bkra bkra ba'i mdangs ldan du ma'i skur bstan te/ /gdul bya 'dul mdzad 'dul ba'i thabs la mnga' brnyes skyed mdzad yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de sras rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i zhing*/ /bsam yas bkod pa 'byams klas pas/ /'di ni mi mjed 'jig rten te/ /sprul pa'i sku yi zhing zhes bgyi/ /gang tshe bskal bzang dus 'di la/ /rnam 'dren brgya phrag bcu dang ni/ /gnyis kyi lhag pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rim gyis 'byon 'gyur de yang ni/ /'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub dang*/ /'od srungs bde bar gshegs pa'i rjes/ /skye rgu'i tshe lo brgya pa'i tshe/ /shākya'i rgyal po nye bar byon/ / de yi bstan pa lnga stong du/ /gnas par 'gyur zhes gsungs pa las/ /sngon chad lo grangs sum stong dang*/ /bcu yis lhag pa'i bzhi brgya song*/ /stong dang lnga brgya dgu bcu snyed/ /slad nas gnas 'gyur lnga brgya phrag /bdun pa mngon pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /'dzam bu gling gi byang phyogs char/ /rang dpal rnam par 'byor gyur pas/ /gzhan dpal kun nas 'phrog byed cing*/

/dpal gyi dpal yang 'phel byed pa/ /jing gir gan zhes bya ba byung*/ /de nas rgyal rabs lnga pa'i tshe | | go pe la rgyal rgyal ba'i sras/ /chos rgyal mi dbang sa skyong zhing*/ /dad dang mkhyen rab chen po yis/ /bstan par zhugs shing bstan pa skyong*/ /bstan pa mchog gi brtul zhugs kyis/ /rnam par brgyan pa de yi sras/ /rgyal sras jim gyim zhes grags pa/ /rigs gzugs ngang tshul bzang ldan zhing*/ /dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa can/ /brtul zhugs mchog gis rnam par mdzes/ / dad dang shes rab phul du byung*/ /yab mes las 'ongs 'jig rten gyi/ / lugs kyi 'jig rten legs skyong zhing*/ /'chi med chos kyi gtsug lag gi / bstan pa rin chen gsal bar mdzad/ /'di yi mdzad pa gang de chos bzhin mdzad pas chos kyi dbang sgyur thub pa'i dbang pos kyang*/ /bsngags par 'os na bram ze'i rje dang gtsug na zla ba 'jug sred dpal dang dbang po sogs/ / chen por yongs grags mthu stobs cher ldan de dag gis ni nyin re zhing yang phyogs rnams su/ /bstod pa'i sgra dbyangs kun tu sgrogs bgyid smos ci 'tshal te bsngags 'os khyod dpal rgyas bgyid grang*/ /'di yi yab mes sogs kyi bka' drin la/ /byas pa mkhyen nas lan du blan phyir dang*/ /nyid kyis bla med go 'phang brnyes bya'i phyir/ /sngon yang dus gsum rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum/ /

zab mo ston pa shes rab pha rol phyin/ /rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gser bzang 'bar bas bzhengs/ /slar yang rgya chen ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /phal che'i dgongs pa 'khor 'das phal cher gyi/ /rnam par dgod pa ston pa phal po che/ / shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod zhes kyang bya/ /padma'i rgyan dang mdo sde rmad ga cad/ / ces sogs grags pa'ang gser gyis bzhengs dgongs nas/ /yo byad bcas te bzhengs zhes bka' lung ni/ /de yi dge ba'i bshes gyur gang de la/ /nye bar springs nas des kyang de nyid kyi/ /slob ma dge slong shes rab rin chen la/ / legs par bsgos nas dpal ldan sa skya'i shar/ /rgyas sras thu bo spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /zhing gyur zhwa lu zhes bya me glang gi /dbyar zla 'bring la yi ge'i 'du byed la/ /shin tu sbyangs pa bsod nams skyabs la sogs/ /brgya phrag lhag dang rkos gser dras sogs kyi/ /las la rab mkhas bzo sbyangs mang bsogs nas/ /rgyal bas spros pa'i rnam 'phrul ji bzhin du/ /dam chos rin chen 'di ni lhun gyis grub/ /'di ni rgyal bu'i phyag byar 'os pa ste/ /de nyid srid zhi'i che bar rab grags pa/ /kun gyis kyang ni brjod par 'os pa lags// de 'dra bzhengs nas rab tu gnas pa'ang bgyis/ /ji ltar 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig gis/ /rnam par spras pa'i nyi ma shar phyogs nas/ /nub tu shar bas de gsal bgyid pa ltar/ /chos 'di dpal gyi gzi yis rab lham pa/ /nub nas shar du shar ba'i shar phyogs nas/ /brtsams te zhing kun gsal bar bgyis lags grang*/ /de ltar dgongs nas mchod la nan tan mdzod/ /de yi dge bas rgyas sras jim gyim dang*/ /yab yum brgyud par bcas dang de bzhin du/ / btsun mo go go can ni sras dang bcas/ /mched zlar bcas rnams sku tshe ring ba dang | | dpal 'byor phun tshogs bstan dang 'gro ba yi/ /dpal du gyur nas chos tshul kun spyad de/ /mkha' mnyam sems can kun dang thabs cig tu/

/sa dang lam kun bgrod nas srid zhi'i dpal/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po'i go 'phang thob par shog /de lta'i rnam thar rmad byung ba/ /snyan ngag snyan pas bsdebs pa 'di// me glang ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + ta ) bre yi nyer lnga la/ /dpal ldan sa skyar bris pa dge /phyogs dang dus thams cad du bkra shis pa gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /maṅga la yab yum gyis rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang phal po che bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /chos rin po che nye bar bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed kyi rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo | | thugs rje'i chu 'dzin las 'ongs legs bshad kyi/ /thigs pa'i rgyun gyis 'gro ba'i gdung sel zhing*/ /theg pa sna tshogs rgya mtsho chen po la/ /thogs med dbang sgyur bla ma klu dbang rgyal/ /spros med sku yi rnam 'phrul rnam spro zhing*// mi gsung gsung gis smra ngan kun bcom nas/ /mi rtog rtogs pas lta ngan drungs 'byin pa'i/ /dgra bcom srid zhi'i dgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kun gdod nas dag pa'i chos nyid la/ /chags sogs bag chags bcas pas ma chags shing*/ /mtha' dbus dang bral thog mtha' bar dge ba'i/ /dam chos dam pa'i 'jug ngogs de la 'dud/ /dge tshogs dpag med mthu yis dge ba po | | dge legs yon tan du ma'i gter 'chang ba/ /lhar bcas gtsug na gtsug tor bltar mtho ba'i/ /dge 'dun mi dges mi phyed de la 'dud/ / gtsang ma'i lha yi bzang po zhes bsgrags pa'i/ /bskal bzang 'di la bde gshegs stong phrag gi /bzhi par gyur pa shākya'i skyes mchog ste/ /snying rje'i gzings chen brtson pa'i rlung gis bskyod/ /skad cig re la'ang bskal mang tshogs bsags nas/ /ches cher gdul dka' snyigs ma'i 'gro ba la/ /rab tu brtse bas tshe lo brgya pa'i tshe/ /shākya'i rigs 'khrungs 'gro ba'i bla mar byon/ / brgyad cu'i bar bzhugs skye rgu dpag yas pa/ /mngon mtho nges legs go 'phang mchog la bzhag

/thub dbang de ni dbang bcu'i dbang 'byor pa'i/ / dbang phyug gyur phyir skye 'chi'i dbang mi 'gyur/ /'on kyang sku de'i gdul bya rdzogs mkhyen zhing*/ /gdul byar bya ba gzhan gyis dbang gzigs nas/ /mi mchog gdul bya'i kha lo sgyur mdzad de/ /rtag 'dzin gdul bya'i snang ngor zhi tshul bstan/ /ston pa de yi bstan pa lnga brgya pa/ /phrag bcur gnas las lnga brgya bdun pa'i dus/ /'dzam gling lhun po'i ngos dang nye ba'i phyogs/ /hor gyi rigs kyi dbang por dbang sgyur ba/ /mthu dang dpal 'byor che la dbang bsgyur ba'i | | mi dbang de ni jing gir gan zhes grags/ /rgyal po de yi rgyal srid yangs pa ni/ /shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas brtsams gyur nas/ /'dzam gling byang phyogs phal cher dbang du byas/ /de yi sras kyi dam pa ga gan te/ / rgyal tshab mdzad nas rgyal srid ring du bskyangs/ /de sras go yug gan zhes rab grags pas/ /rgyal po'i go 'phang rnam par thob par gyur/ /de yi yab mched mo go gan yin te/ /srid la dbang bsgyur sa yi bdag po gyur/ /de tshe gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs bskor ba'i/ /bod khams chen por thub pa'i bstan pa dang*/ / bstan pa de yi mnga' bdag gcig gyur pa/ /kun mkhyen gnyis pa skad gnyis smra ba po/ /sa skya par grags khams gsum chos kyi rgyal/ /mkhyen rab dbang phyug sa gsum gsal mdzad de/ /nye dbang dang mtshungs go don zhes bya ba/ /nye bar bskul nas shar gyi phyogs su byon/ /tha dad skad smra'i 'gro ba du ma rnams// bstan pa 'chi med bdud rtsi'i sgor bcug nas/ /so so'i skal bzhin rnam grol lam la bkod/ /mo go rgyal po'i gcung gyur rgyal tshab ni/ /go pe la zhes mtshan du grags pa ste/ /bsod nams chen po'i dpal gyis lham pas na/ /lha min dpal yang zil gnon nus pa des/ /nyid kyi bden pa'i dpal dang dkon mchog gi /dpal gyis nag po'i phyogs kyi dpal bcom nas/

/dkar phyogs rnam par spel ba'i gzi yis ni/ /'dzam gling phal cher dbang du mdzad nas bskyangs | | de ni ston pa'i bstan pa'i dbang gyur pas/ /sras yum bcas pas zab dang rgya che'i chos/ /rab mang gsan cing gsan pa ji bzhin du/ /nyams su bzhes dang thub pa'i sku gzugs brgya/ /sras dang slob ma stong gi yongs bskor nas | | nye bar bstan pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams dang*/ /dam chos yi ger bkod pa'i glegs bam khri/ /rang gis bzhengs dang gzhan dag gis bzhengs pa'i | | rtsa lag mdzad cing dge 'dun 'bum phrag snyed/ /bsnyen bkur nas ni chos kyi 'khor lo mchog /rab tu bskor ba'i sbyin bdag mdzad pa sogs/ / bstan pa'i bya ba shin tu rgya chen mdzad/ /rgyal po de la sras mang yod pa las/ / thu bor gyur pa rgyal sras jim gyim ste/ /des shing bstan pa'i bya ba nyid la gzhol | | gnyis par gyur pa rgyal bu mang ga la/ /dad dang shes rab phun tshogs bstan la dad/ /de yi btsun mo puṇḍa rīr bcas pas/ /sa bdag rgyal po yab kyi sku ring la/ /yab yum gcen dang bcas pa'i drin bsab cing*/ /mthar thug kun mkhyen go 'phang thob bya'i phyir/ /yi ge gser dang brkos sogs bzo rigs la/ /legs sbyangs da rig la sogs rgya bod sogs/ /rgyal sras kun gyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ /srid zhi'i phan bde thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhi/ / 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams kun nas bskyed pa'i yum/ /rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i tshul du gsungs rnams dang*/ /gzhan yang rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa yi/ /yon tan phrin las zhing dang gdul bya sogs/ /zab dang rgya che mtha' dbus med ston pa/ /shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod phal chen bcas/ /dri med bai ḍūrya ltar dag pa'i gzhir/ /shin tu sbyangs pa'i gser las rab tu bzhengs/ /na bza' la sogs mchod pas rab mchod de/ /bde gshegs gsung rab tshul bzhin rab gnas bgyis/ /klog dang mchod la brtson par go cha bgos/ /de ltar thub pa'i gsung rab dri ma med/

/bde bar gshegs pa kun gyi thugs kyi gsang*/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i mchod pa'i gnas gyur pa/ /lhag bsam dag pas bzhengs pa las byung ba'i/ /dge ba dri med tsha zer ltar gsal bas/ /sgrib pa'i mun nag tshang tshing rab bcom nas/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes pad tshal rgyas byas te/ /'gro kun legs bshad sbrang rtsis tshim byed shog /sbyin bdag sras dang btsun mor bcas pa yang*/ /skye ba kun tu dal 'byor lus thob ste/ /bde gshegs bde gshegs sras por bcas pa yi/ /gsung rab rgya mtshor rab tu mdzin par shog | tshe 'dir tshe ring 'tshe med tshul bzhin 'tsho/ /tshangs ltar tshul bzhin dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs/ /bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin grub gyur nas | | bde bshegs bstan pa rgyas par byed gyur cig /rgyal khams kun kyang dge zhing mu ge med/ /nad dang 'khrugs long mi dge kun zhi zhing*/ /skye rgu thams cad dge ba'i las lam spyod/ /kun nas dge ba'i lha yis legs skyong shog | 'di yi gnyer du bskos nas gnyer byed pa/ /bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang ni thang ngo ta/ /grogs dang grogs kyi gros su bcas rnams kyang*/ /chos kyi dpal gyis dpal 'byor phun tshogs shog /de ltar rgyal sras rgyal ba'i rjes 'jug pas/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab ji ltar bzhengs tshul dang*/ /bsngo ba'i tshig 'di rgyal ba'i chos smra ba'i/ /dge slong 'phags pas rgyal bu rgyal phyir sbyar/ / shing mo phag gi lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes brgyad la/ tsom mdo gnas sar du sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅/ /ji big de mur gyis phal chen gser 'od stong phrag brgya pa rnams bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ /bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo | | thugs rje'i thugs ni kun nas rnam dag cing*/ /mkhyen pas mkhyen par bya ba kun mkhyen pa/ /bla med bla ma'i zhabs kyi padma ni/ /gtsug gis gtsug gi nor bzhin bkur bar bgyi/ /dge bas dge ba'i 'bras bu rab brnyes nas/

/ mdzad pas mdzad par bgyi ba kun bsgrubs pas/ /lha dang lha min mi yis gus btud pa/ /kun mkhyen kun phan mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsung rab gsung snyan snyan pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /blo ngan blo yi mun pa rnam bsal nas/ /shes bya shes pa'i snang ba bskyed byed pa/ /dam chos dam pas bsngags pa de la 'dud/ / dge dang dge ba'i 'bras bu dam pa la/ /'dun pas 'dun pa'i dge ba rnam 'phel bas/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i chos la nyer gzhol ba/ /dge 'dun dge ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di ltar rgyu dang rkyen la ma ltos pa'i chos 'ga' yang med pa de'i phyir/ 'jig rten gyi khams dang sems can gyi khams thams cad kyang thog ma med pa'i ngang tshul can no/ /rig pa las rig pa 'byung ba chos gzhan la ltos pa med cing*/ snod kyi 'jig rten khyad par dang bcas pa yang 'gro ba'i las las 'byung ba de'i phyir/ tha ma med par yang rig par bya'o/ /de lta na'ang 'jig rten gyi khams 'byung ba'i rim pa la ni bskal pa zhes brjod do | | bskal ba 'di ni bzang po ste/ gang 'jig rten gyi khams 'di chags pa'i tshe | me tog u dumwā ra stong byung ba'i mtshan ma/ 'od gsal gyi rigs kyi lha rnams kyis mthong nas/ /kye ma bskal pa 'di ni bzang po ste/ sangs rgyas stong 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes lha'i bu de dag gis ming du btags pa'i phyir ro/ / stong du tshang ba'i sangs rgyas de dag las/ skye rgu rnams kyi tshe lo bzhi khri pa'i dus su 'khor ba 'jig dang*/ sum khri pa'i dus su gser thub dang*/ nyi khri ba la 'od srungs rnams byon zin la/ skye rgu rnams kyi tshe lo brgya pa la/ shākya'i rigs su nye bar 'khrungs nas khams gsum gyi chos kyi rgyal por mnga' mdzad pa gang yin pa de ni bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa des/ sku de nyid kyis 'dul ba'i gdul bya rnams kyi don yongs su rdzogs par thugs su chud nas zad cing gtugs par mi mnga' zin yang*/

yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba chen po'i tshul bstan te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de'i bstan pa lo lnga brgya phrag bcur gnas pa las/ phrag dang po la ni dgra bcom pa thob pa mang*/ gnyis pa la ni phyir mi 'ong ba thob pa mang*/ gsum pa la ni rgyun tu zhugs pa thob pa mang ste/ 'bras bu'i dus gsum mo// //lnga brgya pa phrag bzhi pa la lhag mthong dang ldan pa mang ngo*/ /lnga pa la zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa mang ngo*/ /drug pa la tshul khrims dag pa la gnas pa mang ste/ bsgrubs pa'i dus gsum mo/ /lnga brgya pa phrag bdun pa la mngon pa la nan tan du byed pa mang ngo*/ /brgyad pa la mdo sde la nan tan du byed pa mang ngo*/ /dgu pa la 'dul ba la nan tan du byed pa mang ste/ lung gi dus gsum mo/ /bcu pa la ni de dag tshul bzhin du spyod pa med pa'i phyir/ rtags tsam 'dzin pa ste lnga brgya tha ma'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de'i bstan pa gnas pa'i bar la/ 'phags pa'i yul dang*/ gzhan yang shar dang*/ lho dang*/ nub dang*/ byang gi phyogs su chos dang ldan pa dang*/ mi ldan pa'i rgyal po rab tu byung ba las/ mthu che zhing rgyal srid rab tu yangs pa ni/ byang phyogs su byung ba'i hor gyi rgyal po yin la/ de yang thub pa'i bstan pa lnga brgya pa phrag bdun pa la jing gir rgyal po zhes bya ba 'byung la/ des shar gyi rgya mtsho nas brtsams te/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi byang phyogs su phal che ba la rgyal thabs byas so/ /de'i sras kyi dam pa ni 'o go ta ste/ rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur nas/ ga gan rgyal po zhes bya bar yongs su grags te/ des kyang rgyal thabs ring du mdzad do/ /de'i sras las rgyal thabs thob pa ni go yug gan no/ /de'i yab mched du gyur pa ni mo go rgyal po ste/ des kyang rgyal srid rnam par bskyangs so/ /de'i gcung du gyur pa ni go pe la ste/ gtsug lag gnyis kyi sgo nas/ rgyal po'i go 'phang thob nas/ rgyal thabs rgya cher mdzad do/

/go yug rgyal po'i gcung du gyur pa dbang phyug dang*/ 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pas nye ba'i dbang po dang mtshungs pa ni go don zhes bya'o | | de'i dad pa'i dbang gis khams gsum gyi chos kyi rgyal po mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rjer ldan pa/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po spyan drangs shing bsnyen bkur nas/ de'i byin rlabs kyis sras nye bar bskrun pa ni/ rgyal bu ji big de mur zhes pa rnam par grags pa yin la/ des bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob cing*/ theg pa gsum gyi chos kyi tshul la nye bar zhugs nas/ so so'i brtul zhugs dang thos pa dang bsam pa dang | bsgom pa la ji ltar nus pas nan tan mdzad cing*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab rin po che/ dge ba dang legs pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ nyes pa thams cad drungs nas 'byin pa/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad la yang dag pa'i snang ba bskyed pa'i sgron ma chen po yin par dgongs nas/ yab mched khu bo/ rgyal po lnga po de nyid kyi sku ring*/ chu pho spre'u lo la dbus kyi sa'i cha nas yi ge 'bri ba'i gtsug lag la shin tu sbyangs shing rab tu mkhas pa/ da rig dge slong dpal 'byor dar dang*/ sum pa dge slong tshul khrims dpal zhes bya ba la sogs pa yi ge pa'i tshogs rab tu mang po dang*/ gzhan yang gser dang*/ rkos dang tshon rtsi dang*/ dras la sogs pa'i bzo la shin tu sbyangs pa'i skye bo mang po bos nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan dang phrin las dang chos kyi sgo dang de mngon du bsgrub pa'i lam gyi tshul dang*/ de'i zhing dang gdul bya'i rnam grangs dang de dag gi las dang lus dang*/ tshe dang 'byor pa la sogs pa

| chos can dang*/ chos kyi dbyings zab pa dang*/ rgya che ba mtha' dang dbus med pa gsal bar ston pa shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo sde/ sangs rgyas phal po che/ mdo sde'i dbang po gser 'od dam pa dang bcas pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi gsang ba/ 'phags pa'i tshogs thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyis mchod pa'i gnas | 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhi | shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa rnams/ bai dūrya'i rang bzhin gyi gzhi la yongs su dag pa'i gser gyis bzhengs nas/ glegs shing dang | glegs thags dang*/ na bza' la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad rnams kyis zhabs 'bring byas te/ gsung rab las 'byung ba'i tshul bzhin du rab tu gnas pa'ang legs par bgyis nas/ klog pa dang mchod pa la 'bad pa bgyi bar yang dam bcas so// //de ltar thams cad mkhyen pa rgyal ba'i gsung*/ /'jig rten snang bar bgyid pa dam pa'i chos/ /lhag pa'i bsam pas bris dang klog pa dang*/ /mchod cing bkur bsti bgyid pa las byung ba'i/ /dge ba rgya chen dri med gang thob pa/ / de yis thub pa'i gsung rab dam pa'i chos/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing du rtag tu rgyas gyur nas/ /skye rgu kun gyis tshul bzhin bsgrub par shog /sbyin bdag skye shing skye ba thams cad du/ /dal ba 'byor pa lha mi'i lus thob nas/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras po thams cad las/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho thos shing 'dzin par shog/ tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs/ /gdung rgyud 'phel zhing bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin 'grub gyur nas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas par byed par shog /snod kyi 'jig rten rtsi bcud phun sum tshogs/ /lha klus dus su char 'bebs lo tog 'phel/ /skye rgu'i nad dang mu ge gdug sems zhi | | thams cad chos kyi dpal dang ldan par shog

/'di yi skul byed dge slong 'phags pa ste/ /de la yang ni rgyal bu de nyid kyi/ /gsung gis bskul nas ji ltar bzhengs tshul dang*/ /bsngo ba'i tshigs su bcad pa de yis bgyis/ /'di la 'dun pas yo byad nyer sbyor dang*/ /gnyer byed pa dang de yi grogs byed dang*/ / yi rang byed pa'i skye bo thams cad la'ang*/ /tshe 'dir phun tshogs mthar thug sangs rgyas shog /chu mo bya'i dpyid zla 'bring po la/ g.yar mo thang gi sa'i cha shing kun du bris pa'o/ /phyogs dang mtshams dang dus kun tu bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ / ¡Ã a rog ches ( ¡¶ zha ¡· rgyal po algo cha'i ) 'bum bzhengs pa'i rab byed bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / srid zhi'i bde legs ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ /dus gsum rgyal ba skyed par byed pa'i yum/ /shes rab pha rol phyin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyu lam rnam pa'i rang bzhin skye med par/ / bsgom pa goms zhing sbyor ba rnam bzhi yi/ /phrin las bcas pa'i chos sku legs brnyes pa/ /bde gshegs skyob pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yi ge'i ming tshig sna tshogs sbyor ba yi/ /brjod pas brjod du med pa'i don ston zhing*/ zab cing spros bral ngang du zhi byed pa/ /chags bral dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo | | bgrod pa gcig lam chos la zhugs gyur zhing*/ /sems can kun don bsgrub pa'i go bgos nas/ /kun mkhyen ye shes rgya mtshor nyer gzhol ba/ / rgyal sras dge 'dun che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid gyur pa/ /gang las dkon mchog gsum ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - gsum ) dge ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + ba ) gsum 'byung zhing*/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa/ /mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub pa'i bstan pa lnga brgya bdun pa'i tshe/ /rang gis sngon dge spyad pa'i 'bras smin pas/

/hor gyi rigs kyi gtso bor nyer bskrun zhing*/ /blo dang mthu stobs phun sum tshogs gyur pas/ /'dzam gling byang phyogs srid la dbang gyur ( ¡¶ zha ¡· bsgyur ) pa'i/ /rgyal po'i mchog gyur de ni jing gir gan/ /de yis lo grangs sum cu lhag pa ru/ /rgyal srid bskyangs na de sras mchog gyur pa/ /ga gan rgyal pos rgyal thabs ring du mdzad/ /de sras go yug gan zhes bya bas kyang*/ /rgyal srid gtso bo rnam par thob par gyur/ /de yi yab mched mo go gan zhes bya/ /rgyal srid bzung nas de rjes de yi gcung*/ /go pe la zhes mtshan du rab grags pa/ /dad dang shes rab brtse ba'i ngang tshul can/ / bden pa'i stobs kyis sa chen skyong ba yi/ /rgyal chen nyid gyur btsun mo'i mchog gyur pa/ /cha'u ga dun zhes grags zung gi sras/ /jim gyim maṅga la dang no mo gan/ /de dag gi gcung a rog che zhes pas/ /yab dang gcen gyi drin lan bsabs phyir dang*/ /rang gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob bya'i phyir/ /rgya bod sa mtshams shing kun zhes bya bar/ /shing pho khyi lo'i ston zla rnam gsum la | | dge slong da rig zhes byas gtsor byas pa'i/ /yig mkhan rnams dang gzhan yang bzo rig la/ /mkhas pa shin tu mang po nyer bsdus nas/ /rgyal ba'i yum gyur shes rab pha rol phyin/ /stong phrag brgya pa gser gyi rang bzhin las | | nye bar bsgrubs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyis/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog / gnas skabs rgyal po mchog dang gcen rnams dang*/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyang*/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /rtag tu dam chos tshul bzhin spyod par shog /shing pho khyi'i lo ston zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu gsum la bris pa'i yi ge'o// // ༄༅/ /go pe las rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /gsung rab rin po che rnam par bkod pa'i mtshon byed ces bya ba/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma dam pa rnams kyi rang bzhin ni/ /bla med sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus slad | | bla na med pa'i dpal 'bras kun stsol ba'i/ /bla med bla ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten snang mdzad sgron ma mchog /lha brgya'i gtsug gi nor bus zhabs mchod cing*/ /lha min sde dang bcas pa zil mnon pa | | lha yi lhar gyur lha mchog sangs rgyas rgyal/ /chos gang thog ma bar dang mthar dge bas/ /chos min rdul dang mun pa rnam bsal nas/ /chos kyi snang bas zhi ba'i dpal bskyed pa/ /chos bzang nges 'byin lam la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dge ba spyad pa'i rgyu las legs bskrun zhing*/ /dge legs lam la gcig tu gzhol gyur pa/ /dge 'dun rgya mtsho rgya mtsho'i sprin tshogs la/ /dge ba spel slad phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/ /skye 'gag du mar snang ba'i chos rnams kun | | skye 'gag med pa'i dbyings su legs bstan pas/ /skye sogs srid zhi'i mtha' las rnam grol ba/ /skye med rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di ltar bskal pa'i mchog gyur bskal bzangs kyi/ /skye rgu'i tshe lo brgya pa'i dus babs tshe | | shākya'i rgyal po chos kyi rgyal por byon/ /gsung rab rin chen 'gro la rab gsal gyur/ /des bstan bstan pa lnga brgya bdun pa la/ /'dzam bus mtshon pa 'dzam gling byang phyogs su/ /hor gyi rigs byung rigs gzhan zil gnon pa/ / jing gir gan zhes rab grags grags chen des/ /rang gi dbang gis yul kun dbang du byas/ /de rjes rgyal rabs lnga pa'i rgyal po mchog /go pe la zhes 'gro la rab grags pas/ /rgyal thabs mdzad pas rgyal srid snga ma bas/ /ches cher 'phel zhing chos bzhin rnam par bskyangs/ /'gro ba dpal 'byor gnyis kyis 'byor par gyur/ /sa bdag de ni bstan la rab gus shing*/ khyad par bod khams dag la thugs brtse bas/ /gangs can skyong ba'i bkod pa rgya cher mdzad//

bye brag mdo khams zal mo sgang zhes pa/ /shar nub lho byang sde dang yan lag bcas | | kun la phan phyir kun gyi gtso bor ni/ /ston tshul zhes bya ba la dbang rab bskur/ /de yi grogs dang yul khams bsrung ba'i phyir/ /yu gur rigs byung ga ra go jo yi/ /mkhar du skyes pa ga nim du zhes bya/ /de yi bu ni du gal ¡Ã ga ya sti ( ¡¶ zha ¡· g.ya' spang ste ) / /de yi khyim zla dus mis de rim mo/ /de dag gi bu yug run ga ya ste/ /de yi nu bo ze 'un ( ¡¶ zha ¡· win ) ga ya yin/ /tha chungs e se na zhes bya ba 'di/ /lung dang bka' rtags phyag rgya dang bcas pa/ /nye bar bskos shing bskos pa'i bya ba bsgrubs/ /'di yi bla ma srid gsum gsal mdzad pa | khams gsum rnam 'dren lam gsum ston pa po/ /sa skya paṇḍi ta zhes grags pa yin/ /de yi drin gyis bstan la rab zhugs nas/ /bstan pas bsgrub bya sangs rgyas thob phyir dang*/ /rgyal po yab sras btsun mor bcas pa rnams/ /sku tshe ring zhing chab srid brtan phyir dang*/ /pha ma sogs kyi drin lan bsabs phyir dang | | rgyal khams chos kyis shis par bya ba'i phyir/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum gyur pa/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma rgyas 'bring gsum/ /shing pho khyi lo'i ston zla rnam gsum la/ /smar khams tsom mdo gnas sar zhes bya bar/ /bzo sbyangs mkhas pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs te/ /bai ḍūrya dang mtshungs pa'i gzhi rten la/ /gser bzang zhun mas legs par bzhengs nas kyang*/ /zhus dag dras dang glegs shing glegs thag dang*/ /na bza'i bar gyis rim gro cher bgyis shing | | dri med lung gi tshul las 'byung ba bzhin/ /rab tu gnas pa yongs su rdzogs bgyis te/ kha na ma tho med cing dge ba yi/ /yo byad tshogs kyi bsnyen bkur 'bul ba bgyis/ /slad nas dge ba spel zhing rgyun bsring phyir/ /chos 'di legs par gsan zhing thugs chud pas/ /bsod nams zhing gi mchog la phul nas kyang*/

/klog dang kha ton mchod pa rgyas bgyid pa'i/ /bkod pa bgyis pa'i dge ba rgya chen dang*/ /gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i dus gsum dge ba kun/ / lhag bsam dag pas gcig tu bsdoms bgyis nas/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub dam pa thob par shog / gnas skabs sa bdag yab sras sku tshe ring*/ /rgyal khams chos dang ldan zhing bde legs shog /bdag kyang tshe ring nad med bar chad zhi/ /bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ /mi pham rgyal po mngon par byang chub tshe/ /de yis byang chub dam par lung ston shog /de lta'i don ston byed pa'i tshig sbyor 'di | | shing mo phag lo'i bya spo'i zla ba yi/ /bco lnga'i nyin par tsom mdo gnas sar du/ /legs par bris pa kun tu bde legs shog/ // ༄༅/ /dge 'dun bzang po sogs kyis ¡Ã sher phyin ( ¡¶ zha ¡· sher phyin ) rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed bzhugs/ ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos kyi dbyings las nye bar byung zhing chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang tshul can/ /ji snyed gzigs pa'i mkhyen pa gsal zhing mkhyen bzhin 'gro ba'i don mdzad la/ /thugs rje'i thugs kyis rnam par brlan zhing rnam par grol ba'i 'bras stsol ba/ /rgyal ba rnam rgyal kun la 'dun zhing kun nas 'dud pas skyabs su mchi/ /zhi ba chags bral srid pa'i gdung ba ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + rnam par ) sel zhing phun tshogs kyi/ /pha rol son byed bgrod pa gcig lam dam pa rnams kyi spyod yul ba/ /lung gi tshul dang mngon par rtogs pas rnam par bsdus pa'i chos rnams la/ /chos la nges pa'i 'dun pa dge bas dus rnams kun tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi tshul la chos bzhin bzhugs pas chos nyid gzigs pa'i ye shes can/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i chos tshul rgya mtshos rgya cher gyur pa'i blo mnga' ba/

/rgyal sras rnams ni rang rang tshogs dang dgra rgyal bcas pa de bzhin du/ /chos kyi tshul bzhin zhugs pa'i tshogs la tshul bzhin gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar dkon mchog kun nas dge ba'i bka' drin mchog gi bde 'gro yi/ /mchog tu gyur nas ston pas bstan la bya ba byas pas 'jig rten dang*/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i dpal 'byor brnyes nas bstan pa 'gro la gsal mdzad pa/ /rab tu mang po 'jig rten 'di ni rnam par brgyan zhing dge bar mdzad/ /gangs can 'dir ni gangs kyi ri ltar rnam par dkar ba'i thugs mnga' ba/ /tshul bzhin sa skyong rgyal po dam pa tho tho ri dang de bzhin du | | 'gro la thugs rje'i spyan ras ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + kyis ) gzigs pa ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - pa ) srong btsan sgam po zhes bya dang*/ /mkhyen rab gsal bas 'jig rten gsal mdzad khri srong sde btsan zhes grags dang*/ /gsang bdag nyid bzhin bstan pa bsrung mdzad ral pa can la sogs pa yi/ /rgyal po rnams dang paṇḍi ta dang sgyur byed dam pa de dag gis/ /bstan par rin chen bod kyi yul 'dir rgyas par mdzad nas bshes gnyen dang*/ /sbyin bdag rnams kyis bshad nyan bsgrub dang 'bri dang klog sogs tshul bzhin spyad/ /de dag rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs nas mdo smad smar klung sgang rar ni/ /rgyal po yab sras sku tshe ring zhing skye rgu thams cad bde legs phyir/ /hor gyi rgyal rabs lnga pa'i sku ring lcags mo lug gi lo la ni | | chos kyi rgyal po sa skya pa zhes grags pa de yi zhabs btud pa/ /dge 'dun bzang po rgyal po thar dang seng ge 'brug la sogs pa yi/ /sgang ra'i rigs gyur nye du dang bcas ban skye rnams kyi dad pa'i blos/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum gyur 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi 'jug ngogs mchog /skye rgu rnams kyi bde ba'i gzhir gyur shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni/ /stong phrag brgya ru rgyas par gsung dang stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa dang*/

/stong phrag brgyad du mdo ru bsdus rnams dri med rin chen gyis bzhengs te/ /rab tu gnas nas rgya cher mchod dang des gsungs bsgrags pa la sogs pa'i/ /dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan gyis bdag cag rnams dang de bzhin du/ /dad ldan sgang ra je 'bum la sogs pha dang khu mes brgyud bcas dang*/ /ma dang phyi mo sogs kyis gtso byas mtha' yas sems can ma lus pa/ /srid pa kun tu srid zhi'i dpal la 'tshe ba med par longs spyod de | | rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bla na med pa'i go 'phang dam pa thob par shog/ // ༄༅/ /rin chen dpal gyis 'bum bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /chos bzhengs pa'i mtshon byaid nyer bar bkod pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams rin chen las grub cing*/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor rnam par rgyas/ /legs par bshad pa'i 'od 'gyed pa/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma la phyag 'tshal/ /nyer zhi'i dkyil 'khor nyer rgyas pa/ /dge mtshan ri bong gis mtshan cing*/ /zhi ba'i 'od kyis zhi mdzad pa/ /dam chos zla ba la phyag 'tshal/ /chos dbyings zhi ba'i nam mkha' la/ /smon lam shugs kyis nyer rgyu zhing*/ /dam chos zla ba'i rjes 'brangs pa/ /dge 'dun skar ma'i tshogs la 'dud/ /thugs rje chen po'i chu 'dzin las/ /gdams pa'i char gyi rgyun phab pas/ /gdul bya'i lo tog smin mdzad pa/ /bla ma klu dbang la phyag 'tshal/ /mtha' bzhi spros las rnam grol yang

| | srid zhi'-i spros pa kun spro la/ /dam pa rnams kyi spyod yul ba/ /shes rab pha rol phyin mar 'dud/ /gnas lnga la ni rab mkhas shing*/ /grags pa'i sa gsum rab gsal ba/ /chos rje sa skya paṇa chen dang*/ /blo gros mchog gi zhabs gtugs shing*/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag /phyag na rdo rje'i sku skyabs dang*/ /dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rin po che/ /ston tshul zhes byas legs skyong ba/ /mdo smad sgang ra'i yul skyes shing*/ /pre nag rigs las byung gyur pa'i/ /rin chen dpal zhes bgyi ba yi/ /hor skad smra ba'i lo tsā bas/ /bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir dang*/ /rgyal po yab sras brgyud par bcas/ / sku tshe ring bar bya phyir dang*/ /pha ma la sogs drin chen gyi/ /drin la len du blan bya'i phyir/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum/ /'phags pa'i tshogs kyi bgrod pa'i lam/ /srid zhi'i bde legs 'byung ba'i gnas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma ni | | stong phrag brgya ru gsungs pa gang*/ /bai ḍūrya 'dra'i mthing shog la/ /rin chen gser gyi rang bzhin gyis/ /me pho byi ba'i lo yi ni/ /dbyar zla rnam pa gsum po la/ /mdo khams zal mo'i sgang du ni/ /nye bar bsgrubs nas grub pa la | | glegs shing glegs thag na bza' sogs/ /zhabs 'bring dag kyang legs bgyis te/ /bsnyen bkur yon dang bcas pa yis/ /mchod gnas dag kyang legs mchod de/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma yi/ /phyag tu phul ba'i dge ba yi/ /bdag dang bdag gi pha ma dang*/ /nye du dang ni rtsa lag dang*/ /chos 'di bzhengs pa'i grogs byed rnams/ /tshe ring nad med bar chad zhi/ /bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ /skye ba kun tu lha mi yi/ /dpal la nye bar longs spyod nas/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog /phyogs dang dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /zin shing gi ston pa btul ba'i tshigs bcad bzhugs//

༄༅/ /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /yod dang med pa la sogs pa/ /lta ngan thams cad rab 'joms pa | | seng ge'i sgra yi dbyangs sgrogs pa/ /thub dbang de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bsod nams dpal 'byor rab rgyas shing*/ /rnam dpyod blo gros chen po pa/ /mi dbang nyid kyis dpang mdzad cing*/ /de nyid kyi ni bkas bskul nas/ /yang dag gsungs pa'i lung gi mda'/ /rigs pa'i rdo rje mde'u rnon can/ /rnam par dpyod pa'i gnam ru las/ /spobs pa'i skyes bus 'phangs pa'i tshe/ /drang srong lam la rab 'bad pas/ /mngon par shes pa'i mig dang ni/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs dang rab ldan yang*/ /thog med srid pa'i bag chags kyis/ /'jig tshogs lta la rab 'chel zhing*/ /thar ba dam pa bsgrub pa yi/ /lam gyi snod du'ang ma gyur pa/ /la bgin zhes bya'i rjes 'brang ba'i/ /zin shing rnams kyis ston pa mchog | rang gi gzhung la rab mkhas shing*/ /che bar rab grags rlom pa yi/ / shin tu myos par gyur pa yis/ /grub pa'i mtha' yi gzhung lugs kun/ /bcom zhing rnam par bsregs rnams kyang*/ /de blo dag pa'i lcags kyi khams/ /yang dag gsungs pa'i bstan pa yi/ /gser 'gyur rtsi yi rab sbyar nas/ /thub pa'i brtul zhugs legs 'dzin pa'i/ /sdom brtson dam par bdag gis bsgyur/ / 'di la mkhas rnams rtag dgyes mdzod/ /dge ba de yis 'gro ba srid/ /nam mkha'i mtha' yis gtugs 'gyur bar/ /ma zhugs log par zhugs pa yi/ / 'gro kun bstan la 'jug par shog /'di ltar rgya'i yul du sngon byung ba/ /tha bo shang la bgin zhes bya ba/ ma'i mngal du la brgyad cu rtsa gnyis gnas nas/ skyes pa'i tshe dben pa la dga' zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin la brtson pas/ 'jig rten pa'i mngon par shes pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul thob cing*/ rang gi slob ma rnams la'ang lam de nyid 'doms par byed pa/ grangs can pa'i grub pa'i mtha' dang tshul mtshungs pa'i gzhung lugs smra ba zhig 'byung la/

/bdag nyid thar par mi 'dod cing | | gnas gzhan mtshan mar 'dzin chags bral/ /'di 'dra gang gis shes te mkhas/ /shes pa ji bzhin spyod pa de/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub nye ba yin/ /blo gros 'jigs med rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po zhes byas legs par sbyar/ / byang chub kho na'i don du bsngo/ /shing mo yos bu'i lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes nyi shu lnga'i nyin par di hing hu'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅/ /chos rjai pa bde bar gshegs dus dbus gtsang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la spring ba ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + dbus gtsang du gser yig pa brdzangs pa'i yi ge ) bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku/ / dam chos 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gter gyur pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ /mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde legs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi dbu mdzad/ bla ma chos rje'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa dbus gtsang na bzhugs pa'i bu slob rnams kyi phyag tu spring ba/ bla ma chos kyi rje dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen pos sems can thams cad yongs su skyong bar mdzad cing*/ rmad du byung ba'i mkhyen rab phun sum tshogs pas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa thugs su chud pa'i bdag nyid chen po des | rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas gdul bya'i sems can du ma gcig gi don rgya chen po mdzad nas/ slar yang 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan du 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i dus la bab par gzigs pa dang*/ rtag par 'dzin pa'i gdul bya 'ga' zhig la mi rtag pa'i mngon par rtogs pa bskyed pa'i phyir dang | le lo can rnams yang dag pa'i lam la nan tan gyis bsgrub tu gzhug pa'i phyir/ sa g.yo ba dang*/ sgra grags pa dang*/ nam mkha' 'od kyis gang ba la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pas/
